motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and disclosure state changes only.

narrative.overview: A restrained dark desktop system for sustained technical work. Conversation and current task stay dominant while operational detail is progressively disclosed.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange marks selection or action, never decoration.

rules.name: The Conversation Rule
rules.body: Tool metadata must not fracture assistant prose.

dos: Do keep workspace-scoped state correct before rendering it.
Do group operational events by turn and reveal details on demand.
donts: Don't use dashboard clutter, nested-card sprawl, or decorative status chrome.
Don't allow stale cross-workspace content or fragmented assistant prose.
